scope: Exact offline exercise-only corrections; no canonical dialogue changed. Changed chips bind the sentence boundary and changed cloze choices test discourse, not only verb endings.

edits.reason: Old chip 2 ended at 좋아해요.; boundary now inside 좋아해요. 지난해. Modifier clause 단풍이 예쁜 must precede 가을 산을, and 올랐던 must precede 설악산이, so only one order assembles. 5 chips, distinct from distractors.
Old chip 2 ended at 됐어요.; boundary now inside 됐어요. 꽤 큰. 하게 됐어요 split is the only way to carry the period inward without a 4-eojeol chip; 요리를 하게 is forced before 됐어요. 4 chips, no distractor overlap.

Old chip 3 ended at 거예요.; boundary now inside 거예요. 봄에는 제주도를. 여행하면서 fused with 건강도 챙기는 so it cannot migrate into the second sentence ('walk around Jeju while traveling', which would also be grammatical). 4 chips, all orders forced, distinct from distractors.
